cues: Hot copper does a similar job by removing hydrogen rather than adding oxygen.
Primary gives an aldehyde, secondary a ketone, both with hydrogen gas.
Tertiary cannot lose hydrogen this way, so it loses water instead, giving an alkene.
Another clean way to tell the three classes apart.
